items.caption: The sculpt bench after three 360-degree Inflate strokes on the belly (simulated hand frames, not real hands): a soft thickening all the way round the waist, and the body mesh and the key both save. Known defect for the Atelier owner: once a shape key exists the Nebula skin shader shell stops showing, so the figure looks plain; the shell copies take the same key but the shader does not survive the morph.
The Atelier before sculpting: the figure with its Nebula bloom skin shader on, the room and menus around it.
Paint skin on the default figure: the Weights view with the left elbow bone picked. Red is where that bone owns the skin (the forearm), blue where it owns none.
